title: SPECIAL ACT ON STRENGTHENING THE COMPETITIVENESS OF AND SUPPORTING THE SEMICONDUCTOR INDUSTRY
title_original: 반도체산업 경쟁력 강화 및 지원에 관한 특별법

metadata.completion_statement: This one Act has been fully translated into English, including all 44 Articles in seven Chapters and all three supplied Addenda. All supplied paragraphs, items, provisos, references, dates, amendment statements, and source omission notices have been retained. The complete MAIN_TEXT_AND_ADDENDA scope is included.
